hints.title: Baseline Reward Assumption
hints.text: Start by assuming the second mouse eats all n pieces of cheese, obtaining total reward sum(reward2).

hints.title: Differential Advantage
hints.text: Giving cheese i to the first mouse instead of the second mouse changes the reward by reward1[i] - reward2[i].

hints.title: Top-K Greedy Selection
hints.text: Sort the differences reward1[i] - reward2[i] descending and choose the k largest values to add to the baseline.

hints.title: Difference Greedy Selection Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting differences takes O(n log n) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exploring all combinations of k cheeses takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space for difference array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Frames the choice around differential gain reward1[i] - reward2[i].
